summary: Web now opens an accessible pre-capture quality dialog from both the voice room and persistent voice dock, matching the Flutter setup flow while retaining the browser's native screen/window chooser. The dock exposes stop while sharing and locks transitions during join/reconnect/capture changes.

checks.name: Full frontend regression suite
checks.observation: All 220 test files and 658 tests passed, including the nine capture-profile mappings, setup-dialog choices, initial profile restoration, both entry points, dock toggle semantics, and Android-browser capture fallback.

checks.name: Web typecheck and production bundle
checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite production build succeeded. Vite reports its existing warning that the minified LiveKit chunk exceeds 500 kB.

checks.name: Flutter quality flow regression
checks.observation: 6 Flutter tests passed for all nine profiles and the native Android picker layout. No Flutter files were changed by this web parity slice.

checks.name: Matched screenshots and real browser capture
checks.observation: No authenticated voice-room browser session or connected Android device was available in this check. The dialog rendering has SSR and layout-contract coverage, but matched viewport screenshots and an actual browser getDisplayMedia → LiveKit publication/stop cycle have not been exercised.

remaining: Capture matched Flutter/web setup-dialog and voice-dock screenshots, test the native browser source chooser and start/stop path on macOS and Windows, and verify the Android app still matches its device-specific permission and capture behavior.
